title: 放置恶魔
description:
Free your hands entirely in this RPG that perfectly blends "casual idle mechanics" with "hardcore buildcrafting"!

Whether you're looking for a game to idle in the corner of your screen to keep you company during your downtime, or you crave a deep dive into skill synergies and gear affixes, you'll find exactly what you're looking for right here.

⚔️ Fully Automated Combat, Effortless Looting Thrills No tedious micromanagement needed—your hero will automatically seek out enemies and unleash skills, allowing you to effortlessly amass wealth during work breaks or leisure time. Watch the screen fill with damage numbers and dazzling loot beams, and experience the pure dopamine rush of a classic loot-grind.

🛡️ Defy the Cookie-Cutter: Deep Build Customization Every piece of dropped gear rolls with randomized affixes. Will you chase the ultimate critical burst, or build an impenetrable fortress of absolute defense? The choice is entirely yours. Through continuous testing and tweaking, forge a build that is uniquely your own.

💎 Diverse Progression: Grow Stronger with Every Click Forge and polish your ultimate weapons, socket them with rare gems, and push your gear far beyond its original limits. Use keys to unlock unpredictable, high-yield challenges; consume various potions at critical moments to instantly alter the pace of battle and acquire powerful buffs.
description_short: Idle Inferno is a desktop idle looter with deep Build elements. Free your hands and let auto-combat sweep the Inferno! Features highly flexible skills, rich gear crafting & diverse progression. Tweak your Build, challenge tougher foes, and enjoy screen-filling loot!
